# read_A: p. 90 (rest of l. 2 to l. 5), pp. 91–92 (images n91–n93), read from the images

## Lines and layout
- p. 90 (n91) is a leaf back with five lines. My part starts on 90.2 after `…མི་སྲིད་དོ༔` (x≈1690): the rest of the line is only `འདི་དང` (x≈1700–1800). Then come 90.3–90.5. That makes 4 print lines in the file for p. 90 (one of them partial).
- p. 91 (n92) is a leaf front with **five** lines. It opens with the horizontal-swirl ornament, then `༔`, then a blank stretch and `༔`. Following the 009 editor, I wrote this as `༄༅༔ ༔`. Line 91.4 opens with a short run of filler dots (left out).
- p. 92 (n93) is a leaf back with **five** lines and no ornament. 92.5 ends with filler dots after `མ་འཇིགས` (the first dot is taken as the tsheg).
- In all: 14 print lines (1 partial + 3 + 5 + 5).
- **Seam with B:** p. 92 ends `…དངོས་ཡིན་པས་མ་འཇིགས་` mid-sentence. p. 93 should open with `ཤིག༔` (or similar). Reader B should check this.

## Method
- I deskewed each page by a projection-profile search: n91 −1.4°, n92 +0.8°, n93 ≈0°.
- Line bands came from row profiles. Headlines after deskew:
  - n91: 136, 190, 246, 302, 352
  - n92: 112, 192, 250, 302, 354
  - n93: 114, 188, 240, 294, 346
- Crops were ×3–×5 in overlapping segments. Doubtful stacks were taken at ×7–×12, with threshold-128 pixel dumps for line ends and some stacks. I used `/usr/bin/python3` with PIL, and deleted the crops afterwards.
- Mid-line tshegs are usually fused to the head bars. Where the image cannot decide, I wrote the tsheg the syllable division requires.

## Other notes on the image
- **92.1 blank:** after `བར་བ་ན་` there is an uninked blank of about 45 px (x≈790–835) before `ཐོང་གཤོལ༔`. The other recension has `བར་བ་ན་བྷན་དྷ༔ ཐ་མ་ན་ཐོང་གཤོལ`. The blank may be an erased word on the block. Nothing is printed, so nothing is written.
- 92.1 `ཐོང་གཤོལ`: the prefix ག is squeezed against the ཤ.
- 92.2 `ཙམ་པ༔` is clear at ×7. The other recension has `ཙམ་སྒྲོག་པ`.
- 92.4 `མ་དངངས་ཤིག`: ད-ང-ང-ས is clear (×5). It is the print's spelling of `སྔངས`. Kept.

## Where this print differs from the other recension in sense or words (print followed)
- 90.3: `བསྒྲགས་པས༔ གསེར་གྱི་མཎྜལ་ལ་…` adds `ལ`.
- 90.3–4: `ཐོས་གྲོལ་གྱི་དགོས་པ་བསྟན་ནས` ("having shown the purpose"), other recension `དགོས་ཆེད`. The sense is the same.
- 90.4: `ཡང་ཚེ་འདས་…བོས་ནས` (other recension `དེ་ཡང་…བོས་ལ`). `ངོ་སྤྲད` (other recension `ངོ་སྤྲོད`).
- 90.5: `ཁྱོད་ཀྱི་གོང་དུ` (other recension `ཁྱོད་ཀྱིས`). **The print adds `དགོས་བྱུང་བ`**: "it happened that you had to wander here", where the other recension has "you are wandering here". Then `ཞག་བརྒྱད་པ་ལ༔` closes the line, and 91.1 begins `ཁྲག་འཐུང་…འོང་ངོ༔`.
- 91.2: `ཞལ་གཡས་དཀར་བ༔ གཡོན་དམར་བ༔` (other recension `གཡས་ཞལ… གཡོན་ཞལ…`).
- 91.3: `ནག་ཏུ`, `སྡང་མིག་ཏུ` (other recension `དུ`).
- 91.4: `བཤུགས་ཀྱི་སྒྲ` (other recension `བཤུག་པའི་སྒྲ`). The other recension's `ཨ་ལ་ལ་དང་༔` has a ༔ that the print lacks.
- **91.5: the head ornaments differ.**
  - The print has `ཉི་ཟླ་དང༔ སྦྲུལ་ནག་དང༔ ཐོད་སྐམ་ཀྱི་དབུར་བརྒྱན་པ༔`: the sun and moon, black snakes and dry skulls are all on the head.
  - The other recension has `ཉི་ཟླ་དང་ཐོད་སྐམ་གྱིས་དབུར་བརྒྱན་པ༔ སྦྲུལ་ནག་དང་ཐོད་རློན་གྱིས་སྐུ་ལ་བརྒྱན་པ༔`, with snakes and **fresh skulls on the body**.
  - The print omits the fresh skulls and the body ornament.
- 91.5: `བར་པ་ན` (other recension `བར་བ་ན`).
- **92.1: the left-hand implements differ.** The print has `བར་བ་ན་ [blank] ཐོང་གཤོལ༔ ཐ་མ་[…]་བསྣམས་པར༔`: the plough is in the **middle** hand, and an unread object is in the last. The other recension has middle `བྷན་དྷ` (skull-cup) and last `ཐོང་གཤོལ`.
- 92.1: `ཡུམ་བུདྡྷ` (other recension `བྷུདྡྷ`), with no `ཀྲོ`-related difference.
- 92.2: `གཡས་པས་མགུལ་ནས་འཁྱུད་ཅིང༔` omits `ཡབ་ཀྱི` and closes with `ཅིང༔` (other recension `…འཁྱུད་པ༔`). `ཐུག་ཆོམ་དང་འུར་སྒྲ` (no ༔). `ལྡིར་བ་ཙམ་པ` omits `སྒྲོག` ("as loud as a dragon's roar"; the verb "proclaims" is missing).
- 92.3: `སྤུ་སེབ་ནས` (other recension `སྤུ་གསེབ`).
- 92.3: `ཁྱུང་གིས་བཏེགས` (other recension `འདེགས`).
- 92.3: `བཞུགས་པར༔`.
- **92.3–4:** `རང་གི་ཀླད་པའི་ཤར་ནས་རང་གི་མངོན་སུམ་ཉི་དེ་ཀ་ལྟར་འཆར་རོ` ("dawning from the east of your brain, he appears to you in front of you, just so"). Other recension: `ཀླད་པའི་ནང་ནས་ཐོན་ནས་རང་ལ་མངོན་སུམ་…` ("emerging from inside your brain"). The phrase `ཤར་ནས` matches the other recension's own wording at day 9.
- 92.4: `རང་གི་རིག་པའི་སྐུར` (other recension `རང་རིག་པའི`). `མ་དངངས` (other recension `མ་སྔངས`).
- 92.5: `ཡིན་པས་མ་འཇིགས་` | p. 93 (other recension `མ་སྐྲག་ཅིག`).

## Line-end tsheg status
- **Ending in ༔:** 90.4, 90.5, 91.5, 92.1, 92.4.
- **With a tsheg:** 92.2 `རྗེ་`; 92.5 `འཇིགས་` (the first of the filler dots).
- **No tsheg** (each needs a fix): 90.2 `དང` (the ང ends against the frame), 90.3 `དགོས`, 91.1 `བུདྡྷ`, 91.2 `སྨུག`, 91.3 `ཟངས`, 91.4 `དུ`, 92.3 `གི`.
- The ornament line 91.1 follows 90.5's ༔, so no join fix is needed.

## Suspected misprints
1. **92.2 `ཙམ་པ༔`** for `ཙམ་སྒྲོག་པ༔`: the verb is missing. The sense ("…as loud as thunder, roaring") needs a verb, but `ཙམ་པ` "being as much as" can stand at a stretch. Kept, note only.
2. **92.4 `ཉི་དེ་ཀ`**: possibly `ཉིད་དེ་ཀ` with ད dropped. Kept, note only.
3. **91.4 `ཧ་ཧའི`** for `ཧ་ཧེའི`: a laugh syllable, uncertain reading. Kept, note only.
4. **92.1 blank** after `བར་བ་ན་`: probably a word erased or missing on the block (other recension `བྷན་དྷ`). Not supplied. The editor's note should say so.

## Open
- The 92.1 gap (two stacks) and the blank before `ཐོང་གཤོལ` should be checked on a better scan (archive.org n93 at w3000).
- 90.5 `དགོས་བྱུང་བ` is an addition the other recension does not have. It is fairly clear at ×12, but a second reader should confirm it.
